connectorUiConfig.title: EasyVista ITSM (via REST API)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown:
The **EasyVista ITSM** data connector ingests IT service management data from [EasyVista Service Manager](https://www.easyvista.com/) via its REST API into Microsoft Sentinel.

This connector provides visibility into:
- **Tickets** (incidents, service requests, change requests, problems, events)
- **Assets** (IT equipment, licenses, contracts)
- **Employees** (user directory and organizational context)
- **Configuration Items** (CMDB entries)

Use this data to correlate ITSM events with security incidents, detect anomalous ticket patterns, track asset-to-incident relationships, and enrich security investigations with organizational context.

Similar to the ServiceNow ITSM integration, this connector enables bi-directional visibility between your ITSM platform and your security operations center.

sampleQueries.description: All high-severity incidents in the last 24 hours
sampleQueries.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where REQUEST_TYPE has "Incident"
| where SEVERITY_ID <= 2
| project TimeGenerated, RFC_NUMBER, TITLE, STATUS_EN, SEVERITY_ID, REQUESTOR_NAME, REQUESTOR_EMAIL, LOCATION_PATH
| order by TimeGenerated desc

sampleQueries.description: Open change requests with SLA breach risk
sampleQueries.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where REQUEST_TYPE has "Change"
| where STATUS_EN !in ("Closed", "Resolved")
| where isnotempty(MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT)
| where MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT < now()
| project RFC_NUMBER, TITLE, STATUS_EN, MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT, REQUESTOR_NAME
| order by MAX_RESOLUTION_DATE_UT asc

EasyVista_Assets_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| summarize AssetCount = dcount(ASSET_ID) by DEPARTMENT_PATH
| order by AssetCount desc

sampleQueries.description: Ticket volume by type and status
sampleQueries.query:
EasyVista_Tickets_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| summarize TicketCount = count() by REQUEST_TYPE, STATUS_EN
| order by TicketCount desc

EasyVista_Employees_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| join kind=leftanti (
    EasyVista_Tickets_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | distinct REQUESTOR_EMAIL
) on $left.E_MAIL == $right.REQUESTOR_EMAIL
| project EMPLOYEE_ID, LAST_NAME, E_MAIL, DEPARTMENT_PATH

customs.name: EasyVista API access
customs.description: An EasyVista Service Manager account with REST API access enabled. You need either a **Bearer token** (recommended) or **username/password** credentials with permissions to read tickets, assets, employees, and configuration items.

instructionSteps.title: Connect EasyVista ITSM to Microsoft Sentinel
instructionSteps.description:
This connector uses the EasyVista REST API to poll ITSM data. You'll need:

1. **EasyVista Server Host** - Your EasyVista server URL (e.g., `mycompany.easyvista.com`)
2. **Account ID** - Your EasyVista account identifier used in API paths
3. **Bearer Token** - An API token generated from your EasyVista admin console ([documentation](https://docs.easyvista.com/docs/rest-api))

Data is polled from 4 endpoints: `/requests` (tickets), `/assets`, `/employees`, and `/configuration_items`.
